overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the ten-councilor endorsement listed in the Mayor's press release was drawn from public comments at an open meeting, not from private deliberation by a quorum.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged that ten of eleven councilors agreed to endorse a matter under consideration outside an open meeting, which would be unlawful deliberation.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find that the Council did not deliberate outside of an open meeting and thus did not violate the Open Meeting Law.

note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
